te: Draft Act on the protection of victims of domestic violence: recommendations in 5 areas (sections 6–15) and the work of 3 subcommittees
se: The meeting reviewed the draft Act on the Protection of Victims of Domestic Violence B.E. .... section by section, from section 6 to section 15, and gave observations and recommendations in 5 areas: prevention before incidents happen, protection that takes the psychological impact into account, coordination between agencies, a review of treatment and penalties, and attention to the family context. The meeting agreed to write to the Treasury Department to ask about progress on the Royal Decree to withdraw the land from public domain status, following a complaint asking for the facts to be checked about state land in the 4th Army Area. It noted progress on a complaint asking for the qualifications of village-headman candidates in Phang Nga Province to be checked, and noted the work of 3 subcommittees on town planning for urban conservation, the seminar on the Licensing Facilitation Act, and disaster safety in schools.
it: Complaint asking for the facts to be checked on alleged encroachment on state land in the 4th Army Area (follow-up)
Complaint asking for the qualifications of village-headman candidates to be checked, Mueang Phang Nga District, Phang Nga Province (follow-up)

Central and Provincial Subcommittee: results of the study on urban development through specific town plans under the Town Planning Act B.E. 2562 (2019), with urban conservation as the case study / progress on the complaint about road lines Kh.2 and Kh.3 in the Bangkok Comprehensive Plan (revision 4), Nong Chok District

Development Subcommittee (State administration system and public sector personnel): progress on the academic seminar on putting the Licensing Facilitation Act B.E. 2569 (2026) into practice, Thursday 20 November 2026, Rama Gardens Hotel
Disaster Subcommittee: study of ways to develop disaster education, preparedness and safety in schools, and cooperation between agencies

Draft Act on the Protection of Victims of Domestic Violence B.E. ....: progress of the House of Representatives' ad hoc committee noted, and sections 6–15 reviewed: (1) more monitoring of at-risk families before incidents, with local administration and communities taking part (2) protection that avoids further psychological harm, especially for children and vulnerable people (3) clear time frames for reporting incidents and passing on information (4) a review of the treatment period for people with drug dependence and of penalties for breaching court orders (5) attention to the safety and rights of victims and to family relationships

Guidelines for conserving and reviving old towns (the Lamphun model), and petitions from Phatthalung and Trang referred to the provincial governors
se: Subcommittees reported on guidelines for conserving and reviving old towns, with information from the Fine Arts Department, the Office of Natural Resources and Environmental Policy and Planning and the founder of Lamphun City Lab; on progress with the seminar on the Licensing Facilitation Act on 20 November 2026; and on observing a water rescue drill on the Mekong River in Nong Khai Province. The meeting agreed to send letters to the Governors of Phatthalung and Trang asking them to check the facts and consider resolving the problems raised in 6 petitions from the Senators Meet the People programme, lower southern group, and to send 2 project proposals from the Ao Tong Subdistrict Administrative Organisation, Trang Province, to the Committee on Agriculture and Cooperatives and the Committee on Tourism and Sports. It also approved the appointment of 3 advisers.
it: Central and Provincial Subcommittee: guidelines for conserving and reviving old towns, with the Fine Arts Department, the Office of Natural Resources and Environmental Policy and Planning (ONEP) and Lamphun City Lab (town-planning measures and laws protecting ancient monuments, buffer zones, and the Lamphun model as a case study)
Development Subcommittee (State administration system and public sector personnel): progress on the seminar on the Licensing Facilitation Act, 20 November 2026, 08.00–16.00 hrs, Rama Gardens Hotel
Disaster Subcommittee: the subcommittee chair observed a water rescue drill on the Mekong River, Nong Khai (a tourist-boat accident scenario, with Thai and Lao PDR agencies training together)

Senators-meet-the-people, lower south, 6 matters: the boundary of public land at Thale Noi, Phatthalung (2 matters) / a complaint alleging illegal use of push nets, Ko Sukon Subdistrict / rights to farmland, Ko Sukon Subdistrict / access to the raft landing at Ta Se pier, Hat Samran District, and in Ko Sukon Subdistrict, Palian District / repair of the Ban Laem fishing pier, Ko Sukon Subdistrict, Trang

Senators-meet-the-people: the Chief Executive of the Ao Tong Subdistrict Administrative Organisation, Wang Wiset District, Trang, proposed 2 projects (developing the Roi Chan Phan Wang Waterfall tourist site / a water-storage weir at Ban Wang Hin with a water-distribution system, Village No. 7, Ao Tong Subdistrict)
Appointment of 1 honorary adviser and 2 advisers to the Central and Provincial Subcommittee (effective 12 November 2026)
